entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while I connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this VeloBand tracker. I'm done with it, and I want a full refund. Now.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It doesn't matter what the issue is! I paid for it, I don't want it, and I want my money back. Just process the return. The order number is VF-129834.
Okay, thank you for that order number. Let me just pull up your details... I see the VeloBand Pulse was delivered to you on December 30th. Is that correct?
Sounds about right. So get on with it. I don't have all day.
Sir, I've reviewed your order against our return guidelines, and unfortunately, it's **too late** to start a return for this item.
What?! What do you mean 'too late'? I just got it!
I understand your frustration. Our return **policy** for the VeloBand Pulse is ten days from the date of delivery. As it's now January 24th, you are well outside that window.
TEN DAYS? That is the most ridiculous policy I have ever heard! This is a scam! I want my money back!

I do apologize for the inconvenience, but that **policy** is in place for very specific reasons. Because the VeloBand is a wearable device that makes direct skin contact, we cannot accept it back after the 10-day window due to strict **hygiene** and health protocols.
Hygiene?! I barely wore the stupid thing! This is completely unacceptable. Get me a supervisor right now. I want to speak to your manager.

I am the highest point of contact for this type of policy issue, and a manager will provide you with the same information. For bio-contaminant and **sanitation** reasons, we are legally unable to accept the device back for a refund. The decision is final.

Final? You think this is final? I am going to light you up on every review site and social media platform there is. I'll make sure everyone knows VeloFit is a rip-off with a garbage policy! You're going to wish you just gave me my refund!

I'm very sorry you feel that way, but I cannot override a company-wide health and **sanitation** **policy**. Since the return period has expired, I am unable to process a refund. Is there anything else I can assist with?
Are you kidding me? No! You haven't assisted with anything! You've just lost a customer forever!
